entities.name: Vaida Sipavičiūtė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vaida Sipavičiūtė is a Lithuanian professional basketball player. She plays for Club Atletico Faenza (Italy) and Lithuania women's national basketball team. She has represented national team in EuroBasket Women 2011 competition. She has spent 4 years in Syracuse Orange team.
